name: atpotato-mentions
description: Watches the atproto firehose for mentions of and replies to atpotato, gates them, asks the eve agent for a draft, gates the draft, and posts it as a reply. Holds the only atproto write credential in the system.

scripts.test: PATH=/opt/node22/bin:$PATH PDS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 CALLBACK_PORT=0 ATPOTATO_DID=did:plc:qntsxa2i4sb24noi45fx4np2 ATPOTATO_HANDLE=atpota.to DB_FILE=:memory: STAGE=4 ATPROTO_APP_PASSWORD=test AGENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1 DROPLET_SHARED_SECRET=test-secret LOG_LEVEL=error GATES_FILE=/nonexistent-gates.json KILL_SWITCH_FILE=/nonexistent-kill /opt/node22/bin/node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.js
